headline: Get Budsquire
title: How to Get Budsquire | Two Regions Two Forms | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Budsquire is a Grass Aniimo with two homes. The basic form lives in the Sea of Flowers at levels nineteen to twenty eight, and in Rosetower Woods at levels forty three to fifty. The Towerwood form is only in Rosetower Woods. At level twenty seven, Budsquire can become Thornblade or Melloblum, but each branch has its own conditions. Which branch will you pick? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Budsquire lives in the Sea of Flowers and Rosetower Woods. At level 27 it can evolve into Thornblade or Melloblum.
